name: Firefly Canvas
description: Full-screen photo background with glowing fireflies drifting across a blurred canvas, each leaving a short fading trail. Fireflies spawn continuously and recycle when they leave the screen.
contents: Canvas layer of drifting fireflies with fading trails
behavior: Fireflies spawn each frame up to a maximum and wander with random heading changes
Fireflies leaving the viewport are removed and respawned
Canvas resizes to the window on resize
editableByProps: Firefly count, spawn rate, color, trail length
Background image and canvas blur class
fixed: Root is position fixed and covers the whole viewport, so it acts as a page background layer
Resize listener on window is removed on unmount
